channel.title: AI Business Harness Insights
channel.description: Practical AI guides for small businesses.

item.title: Grok as One Option Inside an AI Business Harness: What Grok Bot Covers and What It Doesn't
item.description: Grok Bot ships a cloud computer, Auto-review and Enterprise audit controls. See which AI harness pieces it covers and which you still build.

item.title: What Is an AI Business Harness? The Operating Layer Behind Useful AI
item.description: Updated guide to AI harness infrastructure, governance, orchestration, human approval, audit trails, cost controls and provider selection.

item.title: AI Model vs. AI Agent vs. AI Harness: What Business Owners Need to Know
item.description: Model, agent, harness: three words that get used interchangeably. Here's what each one really is, and which one decides whether AI works in your business.

item.title: How to Find the Right Business Workflow to Automate First
item.description: Don't start with the flashiest AI idea. Use this five-question scoring method to find the repetitive task that's actually worth automating first.

item.title: Human Approval in AI Workflows: What Should Stay Under Review?
item.description: Learn where AI workflows should run automatically, where human approval belongs, and which business actions should stay off-limits to AI.

item.title: AI Email Assistants for Small Businesses: What They Should and Shouldn't Do
item.description: An AI email assistant can sort inquiries, draft replies and flag what's urgent. Here's what it should do, what it shouldn't, and how to set one up safely.

item.title: AI Estimate Follow-Up: How Service Businesses Stop Losing Quoted Jobs
item.description: Open estimates that never get a follow-up are lost revenue. Here's how a controlled AI workflow finds them, drafts check-ins and keeps a person in charge.

item.title: How to Connect AI to Your Existing Business Software Without Replacing Everything
item.description: You don't need new software to use AI. Here are the five ways AI connects to the tools you already have, and how to choose the safest one for each workflow.

item.title: AI Browser Automation vs. API Integrations: Which Should Your Business Use?
item.description: AI can now operate websites and desktop apps like a person. When is that the right call, and when should you insist on an API? A practical comparison.

item.title: What to Log When an AI Agent Does Business Work
item.description: If you can't see what your AI did, you can't trust it or fix it. Here's what an AI agent audit trail should record, and what to keep out of it.

item.title: The 30-Day AI Workflow Pilot: A Week-by-Week Plan for Small Businesses
item.description: A practical four-week plan to test one AI workflow in your business, from picking the task and setting a baseline to controlled testing and a go/no-go review.
